conviction_note: 未来工業 releases at 15:00 inside the session (kabutan's 10/23 schedule lists it as 取引時間中, and the last four prints went at 15:00). Q1 delivered 58.2% of the H1 ordinary-profit plan, against 47.0% and 46.5% at the same point in the two prior years. The H1 plan only needs Q2 ordinary profit of 1,438m, where the last two Q2s did 1,739m and 1,879m. The company's plans run conservative (FY26 plan 6,280m, actual 6,899m). Its payout is 50% of EPS or DOE 3%, whichever is higher, so an upward FY revision raises the year-end dividend automatically. That gives a positive lean on H1 beating plan, a possible FY raise and a dividend raise. The lean is held to p_up 58 because the one consensus source already has FY ordinary profit at 7,200m, so a raise to around 7,000m is partly priced, and because the company itself guided a Q2 payback after pre-buying plus lagged naphtha costs. abs_move_pct is 3.8, slightly above the 3.19 proxy, because a revision is likely and the last two prints moved -10% and +8%. impact_sum (+1.3) is about twice impact_scaled (+0.61) because the findings are sized one at a time, while the scaled number carries the sign uncertainty in p_up.

findings.finding: Q1 (Mar 21 to Jun 20) ordinary profit of 2,006m is already 58.2% of the 3,444m H1 plan, against 47.0% (FY25) and 46.5% (FY26) at the same point. To meet the plan, Q2 needs only 1,438m of ordinary profit (operating profit 1,398m, 11.6% margin), where Q2 did 1,739m and 1,879m in the two prior years. Mirai has beaten its own plans before (FY24 H1 initial 2,736m vs actual 3,323m; FY26 plan 6,280m vs actual 6,899m). So the 15:00 batch is likely to show H1 above plan, possibly with an upward FY revision. Under the 50%-payout policy that revision would mechanically raise the 85-yen year-end dividend; at the street's FY net 4,850m that is about 150 yen for the year against 135.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-23 (15:00): Q1 beat its own plan by 51% on operating profit, plus a dividend raise of 35 yen; the stock closed +8% (3,505, +260). 2026-04-23: no FY guide and a dividend cut to 100 yen; -10% (2,844, -316). 2025-10-23: H1 ordinary profit -8% YoY with FY held, progress 51.8% vs a 45.5% five-year average; the stock gave up an early pop and fell about 3.5% over the window. So a held plan on a strong progress rate was sold once, and a beat plus a dividend raise was bought once.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the street's 7,200m FY ordinary profit already sits 12.5% above the company plan, and the stock has held about 3,600 since the July jump. What is not priced is the dividend leg and the H1 差異. A stock pricing a confirmed FY raise and a 150-yen dividend would yield 4.2% at 3,600 against 3.76% on the current 135 yen, and would not sit at PER 13.4 on the company plan. A 0.45 margin ratio also says the leveraged crowd leans short, not long, into the print.
findings.independence: The company's raise of the FY plan and dividend, the 進捗率 and the kabutan histories all rest on one family of documents (the company's own 短信 and notices). Separate weak support: national housing starts +6.1% YoY in August 2026, the fifth straight monthly rise (https://kumanichi.com/articles/2041307, 2026-09-30), against the company's assumption of a weak housing market. That is filed as its own proxy finding below. Consensus 7,200m: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=7931.

findings.finding: National new housing starts rose 6.1% YoY in August 2026 to 63,974 units, the fifth consecutive monthly increase. That cuts against the company's July premise that the housing and building market stays weak (弱含み) through the year, and 電材及び管材 is 77% of sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No record of this stock reacting to a housing-starts surprise. Its reactions follow its own profit and dividend lines (see the guidance finding).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is a public MLIT series, and the YoY rise is a base effect from the April 2025 energy-code rule (省エネ基準適合義務化). It is filed as a small proxy because the company's own plan assumed the opposite, and the plan is the number it may revise.
findings.independence: Independent of the company documents. It is macro-to-company transmission, so it is a hypothesis until the company says it.

findings.finding: Raw-material cost pressure persisted through the quarter. Peer 日東工業 announced a price revision on 2026-09-28 citing continued surges in major raw-material and purchased-component prices from the tense overseas situation, consistent with the lagged naphtha-cost hit Mirai warned would land from Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-23: H1 profit fell on higher raw-material unit costs despite price revisions, and the stock 'gave up an early pop' (MINKABU, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7931&b=n202510230750), about -3.5% over the window.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced and inside guidance: Mirai's 2026-07-23 notice already says raw-material unit prices stay high from Q2 and that H1 profit will worsen. It is filed small only because a cost squeeze deeper than guided would be the one thing that makes Q2 miss the low bar.
findings.independence: Peer document, independent of Mirai's. Mirai's own warning is at https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260723/140120260723598028.pdf.

outside_window.finding: 日東工業's price revision takes effect 2027-04-05, and any Mirai price revision for H2 would feed the FY27/FY28 margin rather than this print.

baseline_tension: Mostly agrees with the baseline: the priced lean is mildly positive (+0.255), the run-up is flat (-1.64% over 20 days) and the margin short is larger than the margin long. The positive case cuts against nothing in positioning. The strongest negative the release could carry is a Q2 payback deeper than guided, with H1 below its plan and an FY plan held or cut; the payback and the cost lag are already in the company's own guide.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative on a public series, p_up toward 50) is about negatives, and the main finding is a positive whose value is what the release ADDS (an H1 差異 and an FY or dividend revision). p_up was already set at 58, partly for the same reason, because the 進捗率 is public. Rule 2 (check the positive before a negative) was met: the only negative is -0.2, and the strongest positive was searched and filed.
